justification: Inspected [ByteCodeElement.java](./byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/description/ByteCodeElement.java#L134) and [ByteCodeElementTokenListTest.java](./byte-buddy-dep/src/test/java/net/bytebuddy/description/ByteCodeElementTokenListTest.java#L14). `TokenList` is a small nested utility type with one field (`tokens`), two constructors, and only three behaviors (`accept`, `wrap`, `get`, plus `size`), all focused on list wrapping/transformation; the test covers only that narrow responsibility. The class does not show the size, method count, or mixed responsibilities typical of insufficient modularization.
